title: US FDA — FDA warns about heavy metal poisoning associated with certain unapproved ayurvedic drug products
instrument: FDA consumer warning: heavy metals in unapproved ayurvedic drug products
version_note: Live page; FDA footer states 'Content current as of: 12/02/2025', used as effective_from. Consumer warning, not a regulation: it states FDA's position and names import alerts 66-41 and 99-42.
